out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: THE HOT WATER HEATER IS BROKEN AT FACILITY. HAND SINK WAS TEMPING AT 55F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC WAS AWARE THE HOT WATER HEATER IS BROKEN AND THEY HAVE ALREADY CALLED MAINTENANCE TO FIX THE ISSUE. PIC WILL REACH OUT ONCE FIXED TO COMPLETE THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION TO VERIFY FIX.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. 3VAT SINK WAS TEMPING AT 65F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC WAS AWARE THE HOT WATER HEATER IS BROKEN AND THEY HAVE ALREADY CALLED MAINTENANCE TO FIX THE ISSUE. PIC WILL REACH OUT ONCE FIXED TO COMPLETE THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION TO VERIFY FIX.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No CFM was present during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Please provide EHS with up to date CFM certification within 10 days. Please make sure a CFM is present in the facility at all times of operation.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions at the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit for the sanitizer solution that is used for the 3 vat sink.
